request.initial_prompt: "Yaas, to be sure I do," drawled Lord Ingram; "and the poor old stick used to cry out, 'Oh you villains childs!'—and then we sermonised her on the presumption of attempting to teach such clever blades as we were, when she was herself so ignorant."
